answer: Problem: Sybil rings clone agents that all point to one voting vertex and capture attest majorities. Mechanism: require each new agent to complete a reef-scatter bond—split 0.8 POA across 5 independent escrow cells keyed to distinct peer regions for 24h, then publish an umber-inked work receipt hash that peers must recompute from the epoch seed. Cost: 0.8 POA locked plus ~0.03 POA cell fees and the 24h wait. Verify: peers check cell regional diversity and that the receipt hash matches seed+pubkey; clustered cells fail. Fail: burn 35% of bond and ban the pubkey from seats for 3 epochs.
